business_summary: GDEP ADVANCE,Inc. engages in the system incubation business in Japan. The company distributes accelerator products, including NVIDIA graphics and computing boards, and XILINX FPGA boards; AI and GPU workstation products; Infiniband network products; servers, such as PCIe GPU, NVIDIA HGX and DGX, ARM-based GPU, and AMD INSTINCT servers; high-end storage products comprising NetApp unified data storage and DDN A3I solution; and file server and NAS QNAP storage products. It also sells software tools comprising Weights & Biases, an experimental management tool for model research; Altair Grid Engine, a distributed resource management system that provides job scheduling, resource management, and other functions; and Altair PBS Professional, a job scheduling software. In addition, the company offers NVIDIA AI Enterprise and NVIDIA Omniverse solutions; cloud rental services; and DX, subscription, implementation and operation support, hardware maintenance, continuous development environment update, support inquiries, maintenance parts stock, dispatch maintenance, performance benchmarks, and private lecture services. Further, it provides AI solutions; visualization solutions for XR and metaverse; storage solutions for big data; and construction and operation system based on customer requests, as well as cloud rental services. GDEP ADVANCE,Inc. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.
